lines.say: Disable the submit button while the form is sending, so a double click can't sign someone up twice.

idea.object: paper receipts that a double click prints
idea.move: the second receipt slides back in on the word

assets.why: the flaw is two receipts a viewer watches print

lines.say: Validate on blur, not while people are still typing their email.
lines.takeaway: Judge a field after it's left

idea.object: a rubber stamp that marks the field INVALID at the first letter
idea.move: after the word it waits until the field is left, then stamps VALID

assets.why: the stamp causes the flaw and makes the fix
